title: CMU
credit: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), free for all uses; created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
legend: Readable key poses (the my-3D2dge format). Times in seconds; every other number is a whole number. Rig frame: forward, right, up.
L and R are the figure's own sides. Directions are percentages and need not add up: [100, 0, 0] and [50, 0, 0] agree.
hips   [forward, right, up]   the pelvis, in percent of standing hip height (100 = standing, 55 = sitting on a chair)
body   [turn, lean, tilt]     the pelvis, degrees: turn + = toward the right, lean + = forward, tilt + = toward the right
chest  [turn, lean, tilt]     the chest, relative to the pelvis; head [turn, lean, tilt] relative to the chest
shL shR    [reach, shrug]     degrees the shoulder swings forward (into a punch or an aim) and up, from rest

armL armR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  which way the arm points from the shoulder to the fist, in chest space (out + = away from the body on that side; [0, 0, -100] hangs down, [100, 0, 0] punches ahead); bend = elbow bend in degrees (0 = straight); twist = degrees the elbow swings round the arm from its natural direction (back and down)
legL legR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  hip to ankle in pelvis space; bend: the knee; twist: from pointing forward
footL footR [down, out, toes]   degrees the foot points down from standing, turns outward, and the toes bend up
blade  [forward, right, up]   (sword clips) the direction of a blade held in the right fist, in chest space
root   [forward, right]       (clips that travel) how far the whole body has moved, in percent of standing hip height
speed  (a clip's header: loops that walk or run in place) how fast the capture travelled, percent of standing hip height a second

Backflip.desc: A standing backflip: a deep swing of the arms, a jump up and over backwards, landing on the feet

Bear.desc: A bear, acted by a person: heavy, lumbering, rearing up with paws raised

Block_Combo.desc: Blocks from a fighting stance: forearm blocks high, middle and low

Boxing_Guard_Loop.desc: A boxer's guard: fists up by the face, bouncing light on the feet, weaving a little. In place

Boxing_Jab.desc: From the guard, a straight jab with the lead fist, snapped back to the guard

Breakdance_Helicopter.desc: Breakdance: on the floor, the legs sweeping round under the body (the helicopter)

Carry_Heavy_Box.desc: Moving a heavy box: squat, lift with effort, carry a few steps, set it down (no box is drawn)

Cartwheel.desc: A cartwheel to the side: hands to the floor one after the other, legs wheeling over, back up to standing

Chicken.desc: A chicken, acted by a person: elbows as flapping wings, pecking, strutting

Chop_Wood.desc: Chopping wood: an axe raised overhead in both hands and brought down hard, again and again (no axe is drawn)

Climb_Ladder.desc: Climbing a ladder hand over hand, rising about a step a second (no ladder is drawn)

Crouch_Walk_Loop.desc: Walking crouched low on deeply bent knees. One cycle, in place

Curtsey.desc: A curtsey: one foot behind, knees dipping, a small bow of the head

Dig.desc: Digging with a spade: foot on the blade, lever back, toss the earth aside (no spade is drawn)

Dive_Roll.desc: Running, a dive forward over something into a shoulder roll, back up and running

Dragon.desc: A dragon, acted by a person: arms as wings, a prowl and a roar

Duck_Thrown_Object.desc: Ducking from something thrown: dropping into a tight crouch with the head covered, staying down, then rising

Duck_Under.desc: Running, ducking low under something, and running on

Fall_On_Face.desc: Toppling forward flat onto the face

Fishing.desc: Fishing: a cast with a rod, waiting, then reeling in (no rod is drawn)

Frankenstein_Walk_Loop.desc: Frankenstein's monster: stiff legs, arms held straight out ahead, a heavy lurching walk. One cycle, in place

Front_Kick.desc: A karate front kick (mae-geri): knee up, foot snapped straight ahead, back to the stance

Get_Up_Face_Down.desc: Getting up from lying face down: push up on the arms, a knee under, stand

Get_Up_From_Back.desc: Getting up from lying on the back: sit up, roll to a knee, stand

Get_Up_From_Side.desc: Getting up from lying on the side

Ghost.desc: A ghost, acted by a person: gliding, arms floating up, a spooky drift

Gorilla_Walk_Loop.desc: A gorilla: hunched, knuckles low, a rolling heavy walk. One cycle, in place

Hop_One_Foot_Loop.desc: Hopping on the left foot, the right held up, arms out for balance. One hop, in place

Hurt_Stomach_Walk_Loop.desc: Walking hunched over, a hand clutching the stomach. One cycle, in place

Jump_Kick.desc: A spinning jump kick (a tornado kick): a run-up, a leap that turns the body round with a high roundhouse kick in the air, landing turned away

Jump_Twist.desc: A jump straight up with a full spin in the air, landing facing forward again

Jumping_Jacks_Loop.desc: Jumping jacks: hop the feet apart while the arms swing up overhead, then back together. One jack, in place

Looking_Around.desc: Standing a little hunched, looking warily about

Monkey.desc: A monkey, acted by a person: hunched, scratching, hopping about

Pick_Up_Box.desc: Walking up to a box, bending to lift it, and carrying it off (no box is drawn)

Punch_Combo.desc: A fighter's punch combination from a guard: jabs, crosses and hooks

Rake_Leaves.desc: Raking leaves with long pulls toward the feet (no rake is drawn)

Robot.desc: A robot, acted by a person: stiff, jerky steps and arm moves in straight lines

Roundhouse_Kick.desc: A karate roundhouse kick (mawashi-geri): the leg swings round in an arc at head height

Run_Jump_Over.desc: Running, a leap over an obstacle, and running on

Run_Loop.desc: A steady run, arms pumping. One stride cycle, in place

Run_Quick_Stop.desc: A run that skids to a sudden stop, leaning back to brake

Search_Ground.desc: Crouching to search the ground, peering about and poking at it

Shake_Hands.desc: Shaking hands with someone in front

Shrug.desc: A shrug: shoulders up, palms turned out, who knows

Side_Kick.desc: A karate side kick (yoko-geri): the body turned side on, the heel driven out sideways

Sit_Down_Get_Up.desc: Sitting down on a chair and getting up again (no chair is drawn)

Sneak_Loop.desc: Sneaking: crouched low, stepping carefully, arms held in close. One cycle, in place

Stepping_Punch.desc: Karate stepping punches (oi-zuki): a long stride forward with a straight punch on each step

Stretch_Yawn.desc: A big stretch with a yawn, arms reaching up overhead

Sweep_Loop.desc: Sweeping the floor with a broom, steady strokes (no broom is drawn). In place

Sword_Lunge.desc: Swordplay: from a guard, a lunge forward with the sword arm thrust straight out, then a recovery back

Waiting_Loop.desc: Waiting impatiently: shifting weight from foot to foot, looking about

Walk_Backwards_Loop.desc: Walking backwards at an easy pace. One cycle, in place

Walk_Loop.desc: An everyday walk at a steady pace, arms swinging loosely. One stride cycle, in place

Wash_Window_Loop.desc: Washing a window: one hand wiping in circles at head height (no window is drawn). In place

Wave_Hello.desc: Waving hello with a raised hand

Wounded_Walk_Loop.desc: Limping on a wounded leg: a short careful step on the bad leg, a longer one on the good. One cycle, in place

Zombie_Walk_Loop.desc: A zombie's shamble: head and shoulders slumped forward, a dragging step, arms hanging. One cycle, in place
